mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_stock_signal_event (event_no, round_time, stocks_id, stocks_shortname, strategy_type, signal_reference_price, style_prior, style_maturity, risk_level, style_effective_month, buy_rule_version, quality_score, feature_snapshot, style_snapshot, eligibility_result, eligibility_reasons, candidate_rank, portfolio_decision, reject_reason, formal_batch_id, shadow_batch_id, shadow_candidate_batch_id, later_mfe, later_mae, resolved_at, observation_result, observation_data_incomplete, theoretical_entry_time, theoretical_entry_price, theoretical_exit_signal_time, theoretical_exit_time, theoretical_exit_price, theoretical_close_type, theoretical_net_return, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{event.eventNo}, #{event.roundTime}, #{event.stocksId}, #{event.stocksShortname}, #{event.strategyType}, #{event.signalReferencePrice}, #{event.stylePrior}, #{event.styleMaturity}, #{event.riskLevel}, #{event.styleEffectiveMonth}, #{event.buyRuleVersion}, #{event.qualityScore}, #{event.featureSnapshot, typeHandler=pn.torn.goldeneye.configuration.db.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{event.styleSnapshot, typeHandler=pn.torn.goldeneye.configuration.db.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{event.eligibilityResult}, #{event.eligibilityReasons, typeHandler=pn.torn.goldeneye.configuration.db.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{event.candidateRank}, #{event.portfolioDecision}, #{event.rejectReason}, #{event.formalBatchId}, #{event.shadowBatchId}, #{event.shadowCandidateBatchId}, #{event.laterMfe}, #{event.laterMae}, #{event.resolvedAt}, #{event.observationResult}, #{event.observationDataIncomplete}, #{event.theoreticalEntryTime}, #{event.theoreticalEntryPrice}, #{event.theoreticalExitSignalTime}, #{event.theoreticalExitTime}, #{event.theoreticalExitPrice}, #{event.theoreticalCloseType}, #{event.theoreticalNetReturn}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (stocks_id, strategy_type, round_time, buy_rule_version) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT event.* FROM torn_stock_signal_event event WHERE round_time >= #{startTime} AND round_time < #{endTime} AND portfolio_decision = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_virtual_batch batch WHERE batch.signal_event_id = event.id AND batch.ledger_type = 'REJECTED_OBSERVATION' AND batch.deleted = 0 ) AND resolved_at IS NULL AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT event.* FROM torn_stock_signal_event event WHERE portfolio_decision = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_virtual_batch batch WHERE batch.signal_event_id = event.id AND batch.ledger_type = 'REJECTED_OBSERVATION' AND batch.deleted = 0 ) AND resolved_at IS NULL AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time ASC, id ASC

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_signal_event event WHERE portfolio_decision = 'REJECTED' AND resolved_at IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_virtual_batch batch WHERE batch.signal_event_id = event.id AND batch.ledger_type = 'REJECTED_OBSERVATION' AND batch.deleted = 0 ) )
